meta.title: Token Pacer — never hit the cap by surprise
meta.description: Claude Code, Codex and Copilot quotas live in your Mac's notch. Real numbers, straight from each provider. No account, no API key, no permissions.

hero.eyebrow: For macOS · lives in the notch
hero.headline: Never hit the cap by surprise
hero.sub: You find out you were at 94% by being told you're at 100% — mid-task, on the afternoon it matters. Token Pacer keeps Claude Code, Codex and Copilot in front of you all day, so you never have to ask.

features.label: Always there, never in the way
features.note: Lives in the notch. Nothing to open, nothing to click, no window in your way.

features.label: Multiple agents, one scale
features.note: Claude Code, Codex and Copilot side by side — each with its own reset clock.

features.label: Real numbers only
features.note: Every figure is the provider's own. Never an estimate, never a guess.

features.label: See where it went
features.note: Pin the panel: split by model, by project, and 30 days of history.

features.label: Nothing to sign into
features.note: No account, no API key, no dashboard. It reads the CLI you already run — that's the whole setup.

features.label: Your usage stays yours
features.note: No telemetry, no Accessibility prompt, nothing uploaded. The only call out is its own update check.

features.label: Twelve ways to wear it
features.note: Twelve marks, twelve running lights. Watch each one work at real size, then pick.

features.label: Free, and it listens
features.note: No price, no tier, no upsell. Send feedback from the menu — it shapes what ships next.

demo.label: Token Pacer in the notch, cycling through its states

captions.pill: Collapsed — what's left, and how long until it resets
captions.hover: Hover — the weekly cap too, no click needed
captions.panel: Pinned — the whole picture, by model, project and provider
captions.warn: Crossing your line expands it on its own, once per window
captions.red: At the cap — the mark reads full, the countdown turns red
captions.reset: Window resets — back to full, on its own
captions.prefs: Your thresholds, your call — one slider sets both marks
captions.looks: Twelve marks, twelve running lights — pick by watching, not by name

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.blurb: Straight to the two people who build Token Pacer. No account, no ticket number.

bug.label: Bug
bug.subject: Bug: the panel stays open after a reset

question.label: Question
question.subject: Question: how is the weekly cap read?

feedback.placeholder: What happened, what you expected, and the steps to get there.
feedback.list: Your address joins the release list. Unsubscribe any time.
feedback.tooLong: Too long to send from here — take it to GitHub or email below.

routes.note: Both open prefilled with what you have typed — GitHub is public and tracked to a release, email is private and takes attachments.

feedback.privacy: Only what you type is sent — nothing is collected from your Mac.
feedback.err: That didn't go through. Try again in a moment.

direct.title: Sent — thank you
direct.note: Every message is read by a person. Expect a reply within a few days.

github.title: GitHub is opening
github.note: The issue is prefilled — add screenshots, then post it. Every issue gets read.

email.title: Your mail app is opening
email.note: The message is prefilled and addressed. Add attachments, then send.
